CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   C. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   B. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   D. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   B. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   D. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   D. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   B. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   C. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   D. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain John the Baptist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Baptism of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Calming the Storm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Feeding the four thousand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. B — Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. D — Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

16. (4 marks)
